responsibility: This is the central MinGW target configuration header that defines the Windows/PE driver specs, preprocessor builtins, default ABI and subtarget masks, startup and library selection, linker command fragments, threading-related self specs, format-attribute overrides, executable-stack policy, and libgcc DLL naming for GNU Windows targets. It determines how GCC preprocesses, links, selects CRT startup objects and libraries, emits target predefined macros like `__MINGW32__`/`_WIN32`, and wires MinGW-specific hooks such as custom format checking and C++ destructor registration behavior.
